text:
Yes, Monzo does freeze accounts. Like all UK-regulated banks, Monzo is legally required to monitor transactions for signs of fraud, money laundering, or breaches of their Terms and Conditions. While a freeze can happen suddenly and feel stressful, it is usually a automated security measure to protect your money or comply with UK financial regulations.

Why Monzo Freezes Accounts

Unusual activity: Sudden large transfers, rapid deposits and withdrawals, or activity that doesn't match how you normally use your account.

Suspected fraud or scams: Receiving funds from an account flagged for fraud, or sending money to a known scammer.

Terms & Conditions breaches: Using a personal account for business purposes, or allowing someone else to use your account.

Verification checks: Outdated ID or unverified sources of income.

What to Do If Your Account Is Frozen

Because of UK "tipping-off" laws (specifically under the Proceeds of Crime Act), Monzo staff are legally prohibited from telling you why your account is frozen while an investigation is underway. However, you can still take clear steps to get help and resolve it:

Check the Monzo App First

Look for a banner or notification on your home screen. Sometimes a freeze is just a temporary security block on a specific payment that you can clear yourself by confirming the transaction was genuine.

Check the Help tab in the app to see if support has already sent you a message requesting documents (such as proof of where a payment came from or updated ID).

Contact Monzo Support

In-App Chat (Fastest): Go to the Help tab in your Monzo app and search for "Account frozen" or "Contact support" to open a chat.

Phone: If you are locked out of the app entirely, call Monzo's UK customer support line on 0800 802 1281 (available 24/7).

Email: You can also reach out to help@monzo.com from the email address registered to your account.

Provide Requested Information Promptly

If Monzo asks for evidence—such as payslips, invoices, or screenshots showing the origin of funds—upload them clearly through the in-app chat. Avoid sending multiple duplicate messages, as this can sometimes reset your place in the review queue.

Check Your Access to Essential Funds

If the review takes more than a few days and you are left without money for essentials (like food, rent, or bills), tell Monzo support immediately. Under UK banking guidelines, banks have a duty to consider releasing funds for essential living expenses if you can provide proof of your circumstances, provided the funds themselves aren't directly suspected of being the proceeds of crime.

Escalate If Necessary

Monzo has up to 8 weeks to investigate and respond to a formal complaint, though most routine security reviews are resolved within a few days to a couple of weeks.

If you feel you have been treated unfairly, your account remains frozen without explanation after 8 weeks, or you receive a "Final Response" letter you disagree with, you can escalate your case for free to the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).
